chunks.heading: THE WORLD: The Convergence Era
chunks.notes: Summarizes the four-book throughline and explicitly flags the unknown follower/archivist who leaves marks and eventually steals the testament.

chunks.notes: Lira's methodical arrival and baseline fieldwork is interrupted by the first inexplicable waveform and the archivist's first marginal note, prompting her unanswered "Who wrote this?"

chunks.heading: Book I Biology of the Modern World
chunks.notes: A cataloged run of anomalies builds to Lira's formalized Hypothesis 1, a corporate threat, and a redaction.

chunks.heading: Book II The Aetheric Systems
chunks.notes: Archive-digging into a buried lab consortium and Operation ReGenesis escalates into political weaponization and a saboteur smear.

chunks.heading: Book II The Aetheric Systems
chunks.notes: A single clandestine note ("Look below") pivots Lira toward suspecting a subterranean organization, closing Book II on a cliffhanger.

chunks.heading: Book III The Human Threshold
chunks.notes: Lira's infiltration, the Midlander engineer's betrayal, corrupted logs, and journal tampering culminate in a second, protective hand annotating her own pages.

chunks.heading: Book III The Human Threshold
chunks.notes: Lira goes into hiding as unpredicted storm patterns and continuing marginal-note breadcrumbs from the still-unrevealed follower close Book III.

chunks.heading: Book IV The Redacted Testament — Final Reckoning
chunks.notes: A one-line pivot framing Book IV as "the testament and the trap," where action's cost becomes absolute.

chunks.heading: Act I — The Peaks Awaken
chunks.notes: Lira assembles a three-person coalition and formalizes a coupled-oscillator model she trusts, unaware the Continuum has already corrupted her inputs.

chunks.heading: Act II — The Descent
chunks.notes: The coalition descends into the Continuum core where Veylor, who "believes in necessary cruelty," confirms he seeded false data into Lira's model years in advance.

chunks.heading: Act III — The Choice and Aftermath
chunks.notes: The pulses produce only partial, unstable results, Lira is captured, and a bulleted list catalogues the world's worsening post-capture state.

chunks.heading: Act III — The Choice and Aftermath
chunks.notes: A summary beat stating Lira's sacrifice only partially worked -- the Continuum is wounded not destroyed, and Veylor survives.

chunks.heading: Final Chapter — The Redacted Testament
chunks.notes: Introduces the final volume itself as a found document -- Lira's fevered handwriting, black-outs, overwritten diagrams, and an unknown hand taking over.

chunks.heading: I. Lira's Descent
chunks.notes: A sleepless journal entry lists near-misses and a redacted Continuum ledger, closing on "This is not paranoia. This is presence."

chunks.heading: II. The Redactions
chunks.notes: Describes black-barred pages, excised coordinates, and stamped-over names as literally "a map of control."

chunks.heading: III. The Coded Passages
chunks.notes: Lira encodes meaning into form because "metaphor survives ink," closing on "The mountain's shadow has a shadow. And it follows me."

chunks.heading: IV. Hallucination and Data
chunks.notes: Precise instrument readings and dream imagery of Veylor merge until "the line between waking and dreaming becomes another sensor."

chunks.heading: V. The Continuum's Hand
chunks.notes: The Continuum overwrites Lira's voice via forced confessions, misspellings, and blank sealed pages meant to "manufacture doubt."

chunks.heading: VI. The Plan She Could Not Publish
chunks.notes: Lira's numbered four-step operation and trusted equations end with her final sentence torn away mid-line.

chunks.heading: VII. The Archivist Revealed
chunks.notes: The archivist reveals themselves as the marginal-note writer, confessing they stole the books "out of obligation and guilt" and that Lira "paid with her life."

chunks.heading: VIII. The World After Lira
chunks.notes: A bulleted aftermath catalogue leads into Lira's legacy becoming "a contested scripture: taught in some academies, banned in others."

chunks.heading: IX. The Final Warning
chunks.notes: The archivist breaks the fourth wall to directly warn/recruit the reader ("You are one of us now... there is only fighting"), closing the book.
